_readme: DELIVERY DAY — vlog 01. Scaffolded; fill in the rest.
TO FILL, in rough order of importance:
1. date     — the actual delivery date, as YYYY-MM-DD. Blank means the
page shows no date at all.
2. description — anything in [square brackets] is a prompt, not copy.
Delete the brackets and write over them.
3. duration — runtime as m:ss. Blank hides the runtime badge.
4. images   — drop frame grabs in public/mygarage/vlog/images/ and list
them here as 'mygarage/vlog/images/<file>'. While this is
empty the Frame Grabs section does not appear.
5. instagram / posts — reel links and blog slugs. Empty means those two
sections stay off the page.
The video link is already in, so the player works. There is no field for
the Up Next section — it is built from the other files in this folder.
LEAVE ALONE: `created` fixes this file's place in the list. Changing it
reorders the section.
SAFE TO DELETE: any field you don't want. Empty arrays and blank strings
just remove that part of the page — nothing breaks.
`views` is typed by hand — there is no YouTube API key in this project, so
nothing can read the real count. Leave it blank to hide it.
